    // Who we are

    One line that keeps looping.

    The Web Academy mark is a single unbroken line folded into a W. Continue its lines and the loop completes into a fingerprint. We teach the way that line works: learn, build, ship, repeat.

    A loop, a fingerprint, the world

    In code a loop keeps running until the job is done. The W is one continuous line folded into a loop — the way programming is learned: learn, build, ship, repeat.

    The arch and the loop are two of the three basic fingerprint patterns. When the lines continue around the W, the shape completes into a fingerprint: a quiet nod to identity and security.

    And the ring that holds the icon is the world in our tagline. Web Academy exists to teach it.

    A loop

    Short lessons, real projects, and a mentor when you get stuck. The rhythm matters more than the volume.

    A fingerprint

    Certificates you can verify, work you can show, a record of what you actually did.

    The world

    Learners in 62 countries. Prices that make sense outside a single currency.

    // The short history

    Four years, one idea

    2022

    Two instructors, one cohort

    A six-week interface course run for twelve people in a borrowed room.

    2023

    The library opens

    Checklists and templates from the cohorts, published free.

    2025

    The live room

    Weekly critique nights become the centre of the academy.

    2026

    Six tracks, 48 mentors

    The same idea, at a scale that still fits in a room.
